TelegramBot.title: TelegramBot
TelegramBot.description: Configuration and runtime state of a hosted Telegram Bot connected to the real Telegram Bot API.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.

name.description: Display name of the Telegram bot.

processedUpdatesCount.description: Total number of real Telegram updates processed by the engine.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

WebSiteProject.title: WebSiteProject

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.

subdomainSlug.description: Requested unique subdomain or repository slug.

provider.description: Deployment provider used to publish the site.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.
